key.name: dark-mode
key.description: When true, PulseTask uses the dark Adwaita color scheme

key.name: week-start
key.description: Controls whether calendars start on Monday or Sunday

key.name: show-overlay
key.description: When true, show the compact floating timer overlay instead of full window

key.name: overlay-opacity
key.description: Opacity of compact overlay window (0-100%)

key.name: show-focus-mode
key.description: When true, disable all notifications and interruptions

key.name: auto-start-next
key.description: Automatically continue to the next task when the current one completes

key.name: show-time-in-title
key.summary: Show remaining time in the window title
key.description: Display the remaining focus time in the execution window title

key.description: Expose PulseTask status through the GNOME Quick Settings widget

key.name: last-quick-settings-position
key.description: Stores the last known slot used for the PulseTask Quick Settings widget

key.name: pause-on-blur
key.description: Pause the active timer when the execution window loses focus

key.name: notification-enabled
key.description: Show desktop notifications for PulseTask events

key.name: notification-timeout
key.description: Default timeout in milliseconds for PulseTask desktop notifications

key.name: expiration-warning-threshold
key.description: How many seconds before expiration to show a warning notification

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.description: Backward-compatible notification toggle retained for existing UI bindings

key.name: expiration-warnings
key.description: Show warning notifications before a task expires

key.name: warning-threshold
key.description: Legacy warning threshold retained for existing settings UI

key.description: Register PulseTask shortcuts with GNOME Shell when the desktop session supports global accelerators

key.name: search-provider-enabled
key.description: Expose PulseTask tasks through GNOME Activities search

key.description: Global accelerator used to pause or resume the active PulseTask group

key.name: shortcut-new-task
key.description: Global accelerator used to open task creation or the task picker in PulseTask

key.name: shortcut-show-stats
key.description: Global accelerator used to present the PulseTask statistics window

key.name: shortcut-bring-window
key.description: Global accelerator used to bring the PulseTask window to the foreground

key.name: last-group-id
key.description: ID of last executed group for quick resume

key.name: default-time-budget
key.summary: Default time budget for new groups

key.description: Show notifications when each task completes

key.name: notify-on-time-exceeded
key.description: Show notifications when task exceeds time budget

key.description: Global keyboard shortcut to skip current task

key.description: Global keyboard shortcut to show/hide overlay window

key.name: stats-retention

key.description: Override system theme with high-contrast colors

key.name: reduce-animation
key.description: Disable animations for reduced motion preference

key.name: screen-reader-mode
key.description: Enhance audio cues and accessibility announcements

key.name: database-path
key.description: Location of SQLite database file

key.name: auto-backup
key.description: Automatically backup database daily
